purpose: Exhaustive source-semantic obligations for v2 translation sameness adjudication.

case-01A.statement: local_value_at is indexed by configuration family and site family
interaction graph is undirected with explicit endpoints and regular degree exactly 2
J and h are real; beta is real and positive
pair contribution is -J times an additive fold over edges of local_value_at(c,left(e))*local_value_at(c,right(e)), identity 0
field contribution is -h times an additive fold over sites of local_value_at(c,i), identity 0
energy(c) is exactly the sum of the pair and field contributions
partition is additive fold of weight(c) over all configurations with identity 0

case-01B.statement: local_value_at is indexed by configuration family and site family
interaction graph is undirected with explicit endpoints and regular degree exactly 2
epsilon and mu are real; beta is real and positive
pair contribution is epsilon times an additive fold over edges of n(c,left(e))*n(c,right(e)), identity 0
one-body contribution is -mu times an additive fold over sites of n(c,i), identity 0
grand_energy(c) is exactly pair contribution plus one-body contribution
grand_partition is additive fold of weight(c) over all configurations with identity 0

case-02A.statement: XOR table contains exactly F⊕F=F, F⊕T=T, T⊕F=T, T⊕T=F
parity(a,r) is fold of XOR over selected_variables(r), mapping each selected variable through value_at(a,v), with initial F
constraint_satisfied(a,r) is equality of parity(a,r) and target(r)
system_satisfied(a) universally requires constraint_satisfied(a,r) for every r in constraint family
value_at is indexed by assignment family and variable family

case-02B.statement: row_sum(a,r) is fold of GF(2) addition over selected_nonzero_variables(r), mapping each selected variable through value_at(a,v), with initial 0
row_satisfied(a,r) is equality of row_sum(a,r) and rhs(r)
system_satisfied(a) universally requires row_satisfied(a,r) for every r in row family
value_at is indexed by assignment family and variable family
selected_nonzero_variables is the sparse row representation of coefficient-1 terms; absent variables are not added to the fold

case-03A.statement: q,v,a are real-valued functions on the continuous time domain
m and k are real and positive

case-03B.statement: q,p,H are real-valued functions on the continuous time domain
m and k are real and positive
